env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^scalar option wire ok$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
stdout '^scalar option wire ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/scalaroption

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"fmt"
)

type Person struct {
	Name string? `json:"name"`
	Age  int?    `json:"age"`
}

type Omitted struct {
	Name string? `json:"name,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	got, err := json.Marshal(Person{Name: "ann"})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if string(got) != `{"name":"ann","age":null}` {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("marshal wire: got %s", got))
	}
	var p Person
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"name":null,"age":7}`), &p); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if p.Name != nil {
		panic("unmarshal name: want none")
	}
	if p.Age == nil || (p.Age ?? -1) != 7 {
		panic("unmarshal age: want some 7")
	}
	empty, err := json.Marshal(Omitted{})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if string(empty) != `{}` {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("omit wire: got %s", empty))
	}
	fmt.Println("scalar option wire ok")
}
